comment: Node.js is declared in .node-version, npm in the packageManager of package.json, Rust in rust-toolchain.toml, PHP in .php-version and Python in .python-version; Go is the pin of @polyspec/kit, which the go line of packages/ordered-json-go/go.mod names. uv installs the Python of pythonBuild; alint, which make layout-check runs, is installed from its release archive with the sha256 of each platform. cargo-audit and govulncheck review the advisories of packages/ordered-json-rust/Cargo.lock and of the Go module. symbolExtractors and the Rust nightly of exceptions are the symbol extractors of the parity check (config/parity.json).

exceptions.reason: the rust symbol extractor of the parity check reads the rustdoc JSON of the crate, which only a nightly writes (rust-lang/rust#76578)
